topic.title: Documentation Topic 1
topic.para: Values in this manual are invented and must not be used for any operational purpose. The Primary Electrical Bus switch position that differs from the expected state requires both pilots to record the condition if the indication does not stabilize within the sample interval. Refer to the related topic for additional sample context. The Autopilot Channel B selector position that differs from the expected state requires the pilot monitoring to record the condition when the associated caution light remains illuminated. Values in this manual are invented and must not be used for any operational purpose. If the Cabin Pressure Controller is inoperative, continue taxi only after both pilots has reviewed the associated sample guidance.

Refer to the related topic for additional sample context. The Center Tank Pumps status message that differs from the expected state requires the pilot monitoring to monitor the condition before the next phase of flight. The Autothrottle switch position that differs from the expected state requires the pilot monitoring to cross-check the condition before the next phase of flight. The Standby Hydraulic selector position that differs from the expected state requires the First Officer to record the condition if the indication does not stabilize within the sample interval. The Weather Radar advisory is expected to read within the sample range of 2 to 12 units during engine start.
